title: Read committed usage documentation
responsibility: Reads expected usage examples from one entity’s committed Markdown document without borrowing another revision.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.text
inputs.description: Committed Markdown containing the unit identity and its expected usage examples.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.unitId
inputs.description: Registered entity that the document must describe.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path of that entity’s committed document.

inputs.name: readUnitDocumentation.tree
inputs.description: Reader pinned to the selected Git revision; working-tree files are never substituted.

inputs.name: readUnitDocumentation.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit and its optional committed documentation path.

inputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation.tree
inputs.description: Revision-pinned reader used to load each declared document.

inputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation.units
inputs.description: Entity views whose declared documentation paths should be replaced with parsed documents.

outputs.name: unitDocumentation
outputs.description: Parsed unit usage document with expected examples and any format problems.

outputs.name: readUnitDocumentation
outputs.description: The parsed committed document, or undefined when no document was declared or readable.

outputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation
outputs.description: Attaches parsed documentation to the supplied entity views; resolves without a return value.
